entries.meaningZh: 与文学作品及其研究有关的
entries.en: The literary festival brings novelists and their readers together for open discussions.
entries.zh: 这个文学节让小说家与读者聚在一起，开展开放式讨论。

entries.meaningZh: 表现出敌意、容易挑衅或攻击的
entries.en: His aggressive tone made a simple disagreement feel like a personal attack.
entries.zh: 他咄咄逼人的语气，让一次简单的意见分歧变得像人身攻击。

entries.meaningZh: 供观众现场欣赏音乐表演的音乐会
entries.en: We bought two tickets for the outdoor concert beside the river.
entries.zh: 我们买了两张河边露天音乐会的门票。

entries.meaningZh: 通常用手指或拨片弹奏的吉他
entries.en: She carried her guitar upstairs and practised quietly before the evening performance.
entries.zh: 她把吉他带上楼，在晚间演出前轻轻地练习弹奏。

entries.meaningZh: 中空且通常呈圆形的管子
entries.en: A narrow tube connects the water tank to the small garden pump.
entries.zh: 一根细管把水箱与花园里的小水泵连接起来。

entries.meaningZh: 根据现有线索推测，大概如此
entries.en: The office lights are still on, so presumably someone is working late.
entries.zh: 办公室的灯还亮着，所以大概有人在加班。

entries.meaningZh: 拘禁被捕者或服刑人员的监所
entries.en: The reporter interviewed the former prisoner after his release from jail.
entries.zh: 这位记者在那名前囚犯获释后采访了他。

entries.meaningZh: 在for the sake of等结构中表示目的或利益
entries.en: For the sake of clarity, please explain each abbreviation the first time it appears.
entries.zh: 为了表达清楚，请在每个缩写首次出现时加以解释。

entries.meaningZh: 从紧张或忙碌中放松下来
entries.en: I like to relax with a book after a demanding day at work.
entries.zh: 工作一天很累之后，我喜欢读本书放松一下。

entries.meaningZh: 电流能够流经的连接回路
entries.en: The technician checked the circuit before reconnecting the equipment to the power supply.
entries.zh: 技术人员检查了电路，然后才把设备重新接上电源。

entries.meaningZh: 尺寸或规模特别大的
entries.en: A giant screen allowed everyone at the back to see the demonstration.
entries.zh: 一块巨大的屏幕让后排所有人都能看到演示。

entries.meaningZh: 使人兴奋并产生期待的
entries.en: The most exciting part of the course was designing our own experiment.
entries.zh: 这门课最令人兴奋的部分，是设计我们自己的实验。

entries.meaningZh: 通过实际操作说明如何使用或完成某事的演示
entries.en: The instructor gave a short demonstration before asking us to try the technique.
entries.zh: 教练先作了简短演示，然后让我们尝试这种技巧。

entries.meaningZh: 主动辞去所担任的职务
entries.en: She decided to resign from the committee after moving to another city.
entries.zh: 搬到另一座城市之后，她决定辞去委员会的职务。

entries.meaningZh: 指出缺点或表达不赞同的看法
entries.en: It is easier to criticize a plan than to suggest a workable alternative.
entries.zh: 批评一项计划，往往比提出可行的替代方案更容易。

entries.meaningZh: 把身体浸入水中洗浴的一次活动
entries.en: After walking through the rain, he enjoyed a warm bath at home.
entries.zh: 冒雨走路之后，他回家舒服地洗了个热水澡。

entries.meaningZh: 缺乏合理判断、显得愚蠢的
entries.en: Ignoring the clear warning would be a stupid risk to take.
entries.zh: 无视这个明确的警告，是愚蠢的冒险行为。

entries.meaningZh: 某些动物身体外部坚硬的保护外壳
entries.en: The child found an empty shell among the pebbles on the beach.
entries.zh: 那个孩子在海滩的鹅卵石间发现了一个空贝壳。

entries.meaningZh: 属于古典音乐传统的
entries.en: The station plays classical music during its quiet late-night programme.
entries.zh: 这家电台在宁静的深夜节目中播放古典音乐。

entries.meaningZh: 某些国家划分的省级行政区域
entries.en: The road links the capital with several farming towns in the northern province.
entries.zh: 这条公路把首都与北部省份的几个农业城镇连接起来。

entries.meaningZh: 购入或取得某项资产、物品等的行为
entries.en: The library announced the acquisition of several letters written by the novelist.
entries.zh: 图书馆宣布获得了这位小说家写的几封信。

entries.meaningZh: 认同社会主义政治主张的人
entries.en: The socialist argued that essential services should remain under public control.
entries.zh: 这位社会主义者主张，基本公共服务应继续由公共部门掌管。

entries.meaningZh: 完全地，而非仅部分如此
entries.en: The revised ending gives the story an altogether different emotional effect.
entries.zh: 修改后的结局，给这个故事带来了完全不同的情感效果。

entries.meaningZh: 针对某人或某事说出的一句评论
entries.en: Her brief remark about the timetable led to a much longer discussion.
entries.zh: 她对时间表的一句简短评论，引出了一场长得多的讨论。

entries.meaningZh: 制作一道食品时所用的一种原料
entries.en: Fresh ginger is the ingredient that gives this soup its distinctive flavour.
entries.zh: 新鲜生姜是赋予这道汤独特风味的原料。

entries.meaningZh: 一个人从事的工作或职业
entries.en: The form asks for your occupation but does not request your employer's name.
entries.zh: 这张表要求填写职业，但不要求填写雇主名称。

entries.meaningZh: 把物品安装、固定在某个支撑物上
entries.en: We plan to mount the camera above the entrance to the laboratory.
entries.zh: 我们打算把摄像头安装在实验室入口上方。

entries.meaningZh: 用符号表达数量之间关系的公式
entries.en: Check that every symbol in the formula is defined before using it.
entries.zh: 使用这个公式之前，请确认其中每个符号都已作出定义。

entries.meaningZh: 最终希望达到、具有根本意义的
entries.en: Our ultimate goal is to make the service useful without making it complicated.
entries.zh: 我们的最终目标，是让这项服务实用而不复杂。

entries.meaningZh: 开展某种活动所需的一套装备
entries.en: Keep your climbing gear in a dry place between trips.
entries.zh: 两次出行之间，请把登山装备存放在干燥的地方。

entries.meaningZh: 阻挡人或物通过的障碍物
entries.en: A temporary barrier kept pedestrians away from the damaged pavement.
entries.zh: 一道临时围挡让行人远离损坏的人行道。

entries.meaningZh: 为损失或伤害提供的补偿款
entries.en: The passengers received compensation after their luggage was damaged during the journey.
entries.zh: 行李在旅途中受损后，乘客们收到了赔偿。

entries.meaningZh: 杀害他人的人
entries.en: The fictional detective gradually discovers the killer's identity through a series of interviews.
entries.zh: 这位虚构的侦探通过一连串访谈，逐渐查明了凶手的身份。

entries.meaningZh: 创作诗歌的人
entries.en: The poet read three new pieces and answered questions about her writing process.
entries.zh: 这位诗人朗读了三首新作，并回答了有关创作过程的问题。

entries.meaningZh: 一起活动、常与违法行为有关的一伙人
entries.en: The novel follows a teenager who tries to leave a local gang.
entries.zh: 这部小说讲述了一名试图脱离当地帮派的少年的故事。

entries.meaningZh: 通过工作或经营获得的收入，通常用复数
entries.en: She puts part of her monthly earnings aside for future study.
entries.zh: 她把每月收入的一部分存起来，留作今后学习之用。

entries.meaningZh: 贴在物品上、说明其内容或性质的标签
entries.en: Read the label before washing the jacket for the first time.
entries.zh: 第一次洗这件夹克之前，请先阅读标签。

entries.meaningZh: 在许多地方或很多人中普遍存在的
entries.en: The proposal received widespread support from teachers, parents and local residents.
entries.zh: 这项提议得到了教师、家长及当地居民的广泛支持。

entries.meaningZh: 公开支持或提倡某种做法
entries.en: Several researchers advocate testing the design on a smaller scale first.
entries.zh: 几位研究人员主张，先以较小规模测试这个设计。

entries.meaningZh: 尚待修改和完善的初步文稿
entries.en: Please send me the first draft so I can comment on its structure.
entries.zh: 请把初稿发给我，以便我对它的结构提出意见。

entries.meaningZh: 远超一般水平、令人惊叹的
entries.en: The exhibition reveals the extraordinary patience required to restore the damaged paintings.
entries.zh: 这个展览展现了修复受损画作所需的非凡耐心。

entries.meaningZh: 正在怀孕的
entries.en: Her sister was pregnant when the family moved into their new house.
entries.zh: 全家搬进新房时，她的姐姐正怀着孕。

entries.meaningZh: 沿轨道绕地球等天体运行的人造卫星
entries.en: The satellite sends images of the coastline to the research centre.
entries.zh: 这颗卫星把海岸线的图像传送到研究中心。

entries.meaningZh: 由本人亲自完成，而非交由别人
entries.en: The director personally thanked every volunteer before the guests arrived.
entries.zh: 客人到来之前，主任亲自感谢了每一位志愿者。

entries.meaningZh: 开始设法处理一个问题或困难
entries.en: We need to tackle the storage problem before adding more features.
entries.zh: 增加更多功能之前，我们需要先着手解决存储问题。

entries.meaningZh: 用可可等原料制成的巧克力食品
entries.en: A little dark chocolate adds richness without making the dessert too sweet.
entries.zh: 少量黑巧克力能增添浓郁口感，而不会让甜点过甜。

entries.meaningZh: 按下后触发某项功能的按钮
entries.en: Press the blue button to save your changes before closing the window.
entries.zh: 关闭窗口之前，请按蓝色按钮保存修改。

entries.meaningZh: 敲击或振动时发声的铃或钟
entries.en: The bell rang just as we reached the classroom door.
entries.zh: 我们刚走到教室门口，铃就响了。

entries.meaningZh: 衣物的统称，通常不可数
entries.en: Pack warm clothing because the evenings can be cold near the lake.
entries.zh: 带上保暖衣物，因为湖边的夜晚可能很冷。

entries.meaningZh: 很棒的，常用于非正式赞赏
entries.en: We had a super afternoon exploring the village and its small museum.
entries.zh: 我们度过了一个很棒的下午，游览了村庄和那家小博物馆。

entries.meaningZh: 用来围住或隔开一片区域的栅栏
entries.en: A wooden fence separates the playground from the busy main road.
entries.zh: 一道木栅栏把操场与繁忙的主干道隔开。

entries.meaningZh: 描绘某个人外貌的肖像作品
entries.en: The portrait shows the artist's mother sitting beside an open window.
entries.zh: 这幅肖像画描绘了艺术家的母亲坐在敞开的窗边。

entries.meaningZh: 聚在一起或捆在一起的一束、一串
entries.en: She placed a small bunch of flowers beside the kitchen window.
entries.zh: 她在厨房窗边放了一小束花。

entries.meaningZh: 对某种情况作出反应
entries.en: How did the team react when you suggested changing the schedule?
entries.zh: 你建议更改时间安排时，团队有什么反应？

entries.meaningZh: 向他人传达信息、想法或感受
entries.en: Clear diagrams can communicate complex ideas more effectively than long paragraphs.
entries.zh: 清晰的图示有时比长篇段落更能有效传达复杂的想法。

entries.meaningZh: 拥有某物的权利或状态
entries.en: The documents establish ownership of the house but say little about its history.
entries.zh: 这些文件证明了房屋的所有权，但几乎没有提及它的历史。

entries.meaningZh: 概述一个人经历与特点的简介
entries.en: Her online profile lists research interests rather than personal contact details.
entries.zh: 她的网络简介列出的是研究兴趣，而非私人联系方式。

entries.meaningZh: 对某项活动表现出的强烈兴趣和热情
entries.en: His enthusiasm for the project encouraged several hesitant students to join.
entries.zh: 他对这个项目的热情，鼓励了几位原本犹豫的学生加入。

entries.meaningZh: 停止发生或停止开展某项活动
entries.en: Construction work will cease at dusk to avoid disturbing nearby residents.
entries.zh: 施工将在黄昏时停止，以免打扰附近居民。

entries.meaningZh: 供游客度假休闲的地方
entries.en: The small coastal resort becomes much quieter after the summer visitors leave.
entries.zh: 夏季游客离开后，这个小型海滨度假胜地安静了许多。

entries.meaningZh: 达到参加某项活动或获得某物的资格要求
entries.en: You must complete the introductory course to qualify for the advanced workshop.
entries.zh: 你必须完成入门课程，才有资格参加高级工作坊。

entries.meaningZh: 用来擦拭等的柔软薄纸或一张纸巾
entries.en: He used a tissue to wipe the rain from his glasses.
entries.zh: 他用一张纸巾擦掉了眼镜上的雨水。

entries.meaningZh: 负责操作某种设备的人
entries.en: The machine operator checks the settings at the start of each shift.
entries.zh: 机器操作员在每个班次开始时都会检查设置。

entries.meaningZh: 能够传播并干扰系统的计算机病毒程序
entries.en: The virus corrupted several files before the security software detected it.
entries.zh: 安全软件发现这个病毒之前，它已经损坏了几个文件。

entries.meaningZh: 关系到整体目标和长期部署的
entries.en: The committee discussed strategic priorities rather than the details of individual tasks.
entries.zh: 委员会讨论的是战略重点，而非各项具体任务的细节。

entries.meaningZh: 协助另一人开展工作的助手
entries.en: The research assistant organised the interviews and checked the consent forms.
entries.zh: 研究助理安排了访谈，并核对了同意书。

entries.meaningZh: 用布、纸等擦去表面的东西
entries.en: Please wipe the table with a clean cloth after lunch.
entries.zh: 午饭后，请用干净的布擦一下桌子。

entries.meaningZh: 在做事过程中遇到某种情况或困难
entries.en: You may encounter unfamiliar abbreviations when reading the older research reports.
entries.zh: 阅读较早的研究报告时，你可能会遇到不熟悉的缩写。

entries.meaningZh: 所允许或需要的最少数量
entries.en: The course requires a minimum of ten participants before it can begin.
entries.zh: 这门课程至少需要十人参加才能开课。

entries.meaningZh: 在某个领域具有最强影响力或优势的
entries.en: One dominant company supplied most of the town's building materials.
entries.zh: 一家占主导地位的公司供应了镇上大部分建筑材料。

entries.meaningZh: 包含许多相互关联部分、难以理解或处理的
entries.en: The instructions seemed complicated until the teacher divided them into smaller steps.
entries.zh: 这些说明起初显得很复杂，直到老师把它们拆成了更小的步骤。

entries.meaningZh: 在某人或某物旁边
entries.en: A narrow cycle path runs alongside the canal through the city.
entries.zh: 一条狭窄的自行车道沿着运河穿过这座城市。

entries.meaningZh: 用作食物的大米或煮熟的米饭
entries.en: The vegetables are served with rice in a separate bowl.
entries.zh: 这些蔬菜配着一碗单独盛放的米饭端上来。

entries.meaningZh: 以图形方式呈现信息或数据的图表
entries.en: The chart compares attendance at the three events over the past year.
entries.zh: 这张图表比较了过去一年三项活动的出席人数。

entries.meaningZh: 足以支持某个说法的证据或证明
entries.en: A convincing explanation is not necessarily proof that the claim is true.
entries.zh: 一个有说服力的解释，并不一定能证明这个说法属实。

entries.meaningZh: 以买卖货物为业的商人
entries.en: The merchant stored imported cloth in a warehouse near the harbour.
entries.zh: 这位商人把进口布匹存放在港口附近的仓库里。

entries.meaningZh: 水受热产生的水蒸气，日常也指其凝结形成的白雾
entries.en: Steam rose from the kettle as she prepared cups for her guests.
entries.zh: 她为客人准备杯子时，水壶里冒出了热气。

entries.meaningZh: 由多轮比赛组成的锦标赛或比赛活动
entries.en: Our team reached the final round of the regional chess tournament.
entries.zh: 我们的队伍进入了地区国际象棋锦标赛的最后一轮。

entries.meaningZh: 热爱某种事物的人，常接of短语
entries.en: As a lover of old buildings, she spent hours exploring the town.
entries.zh: 作为一名古建筑爱好者，她花了几个小时游览这座小镇。

entries.meaningZh: 程度、数量或作用非常大的
entries.en: The volunteers made a tremendous effort to reopen the library after the flood.
entries.zh: 洪水过后，志愿者为重新开放图书馆付出了巨大的努力。

entries.meaningZh: 参议院的一名议员
entries.en: The senator met local residents to hear their concerns about transport.
entries.zh: 这位参议员会见了当地居民，听取他们对交通的关切。

entries.meaningZh: 穿过地下或山体等的通道
entries.en: The train entered a long tunnel shortly after leaving the coastal station.
entries.zh: 火车离开海滨车站不久，就进入了一条长隧道。

entries.meaningZh: 诗歌这一文学形式或诗歌作品的统称
entries.en: Reading poetry aloud helped me notice patterns that I had missed on the page.
entries.zh: 大声朗读诗歌，帮助我注意到了默读时遗漏的规律。

entries.meaningZh: 用于制作衣物等的织物或布料
entries.en: This lightweight fabric makes good curtains for rooms that get strong summer sunlight.
entries.zh: 这种轻薄的布料适合给夏季阳光强烈的房间做窗帘。

entries.meaningZh: 使某种状态或活动能够持续下去
entries.en: Regular discussion helped sustain our interest during the longer parts of the project.
entries.zh: 在项目较漫长的阶段，定期讨论帮助我们保持了兴趣。

entries.meaningZh: 通常指较大型的船只
entries.en: The research vessel remained near the island while the team collected samples.
entries.zh: 团队采集样本期间，考察船一直停留在岛屿附近。

entries.meaningZh: 最近才完成某事，常修饰分词
entries.en: The newly painted benches were not ready for visitors this morning.
entries.zh: 今天早上，这些新刷漆的长椅还不能供游客使用。

entries.meaningZh: 人与人或团体之间的对话和交流
entries.en: The workshop encouraged dialogue between engineers and the people using their designs.
entries.zh: 这次工作坊鼓励工程师与使用其设计的人进行交流。

entries.meaningZh: 英式橄榄球运动
entries.en: He began playing rugby at school and still trains with a local club.
entries.zh: 他在学校开始打英式橄榄球，现在仍在当地俱乐部训练。

entries.meaningZh: 一个群体共同合作、保持一致的状态
entries.en: The captain called for unity after several difficult weeks for the team.
entries.zh: 球队经历了几周艰难时期后，队长呼吁大家团结起来。

entries.meaningZh: 为共同任务或比赛组织起来的小队或队伍
entries.en: The coach selected a squad of twenty players for the upcoming tournament.
entries.zh: 教练选出了由二十名球员组成的队伍，参加即将到来的锦标赛。

entries.meaningZh: 双方都具有或彼此给予的
entries.en: Their collaboration grew from mutual respect rather than agreement on every issue.
entries.zh: 他们的合作源于相互尊重，而非在所有问题上意见一致。

entries.meaningZh: 因某人或某项成就而感到的自豪
entries.en: She took great pride in finishing the difficult course while working full time.
entries.zh: 她一边全职工作一边完成了这门高难度课程，对此深感自豪。

entries.meaningZh: 考虑实际情况、体现合理判断的
entries.en: Taking a short break seems sensible after several hours of concentrated work.
entries.zh: 专注工作几个小时后，稍作休息是明智的。

entries.meaningZh: 组织主要管理人员所在的总部
entries.en: The charity moved its headquarters closer to the communities it serves.
entries.zh: 这家慈善机构把总部搬到了更靠近其服务社区的地方。

entries.meaningZh: 为肯定付出或好行为而给予的回报
entries.en: The pleasure of seeing the garden flourish was a reward in itself.
entries.zh: 看到花园欣欣向荣的喜悦，本身就是一种回报。

entries.meaningZh: 通过歌唱进行表演的人
entries.en: The singer paused briefly before beginning the final song of the evening.
entries.zh: 这位歌手短暂停顿后，开始演唱当晚的最后一首歌。

entries.meaningZh: 公开告知某项消息的声明或通知
entries.en: We are waiting for an announcement about the new opening hours.
entries.zh: 我们正在等待有关新开放时间的通知。

entries.meaningZh: 向具有相关知识的人请教或征求意见
entries.en: The designers will consult local residents before finalising the new park layout.
entries.zh: 设计人员将在最终确定公园新布局前征求当地居民的意见。

entries.meaningZh: 直到某个时间或情况出现为止
entries.en: We waited in the library till the heavy rain had stopped.
entries.zh: 我们在图书馆一直等到大雨停了。

entries.meaningZh: 很难或不可能避免发生的
entries.en: Some confusion was inevitable when the old and new systems ran together.
entries.zh: 新旧系统同时运行时，出现一些混乱是不可避免的。

entries.meaningZh: 运用双手制作物品的技艺或手艺
entries.en: She learned the craft of bookbinding from a retired museum conservator.
entries.zh: 她向一位退休的博物馆修复师学习了手工装订书籍的技艺。

entries.meaningZh: 对某个想法正确性的坚定信念
entries.en: He spoke with conviction, even when several listeners questioned his conclusions.
entries.zh: 即使有几位听众质疑他的结论，他说话时仍充满信心。

entries.meaningZh: 为政治等目的实施恐怖暴力的人
entries.en: The film follows a journalist investigating the motives of a captured terrorist.
entries.zh: 这部电影讲述了一名记者调查被捕恐怖分子动机的故事。

entries.meaningZh: 用球拍隔网击球的网球运动
entries.en: We usually play tennis on Sunday mornings when the public courts are quiet.
entries.zh: 我们通常在周日早上公共球场人少时打网球。

entries.meaningZh: 通过身体动作在水中前进
entries.en: The children learned to swim in the small pool near their school.
entries.zh: 孩子们在学校附近的小泳池里学会了游泳。

entries.meaningZh: 强调某事，使其更容易受到注意
entries.en: The final paragraph should highlight the main limitation of the study.
entries.zh: 最后一段应当突出这项研究的主要局限。

entries.meaningZh: 在某件事之前发生或已经存在的
entries.en: No prior experience is required, but you should read the introductory notes.
entries.zh: 虽然不要求具备相关经验，但你应先阅读入门说明。

entries.meaningZh: 涉及思考、理解等智力活动的
entries.en: The course offers an intellectual challenge without assuming specialist knowledge.
entries.zh: 这门课程能带来智力上的挑战，却不预设学生具备专业知识。

entries.meaningZh: 对某人实施的暴力袭击
entries.en: The witness described the assault but could not identify the attacker.
entries.zh: 这位目击者描述了袭击经过，但无法辨认袭击者。

entries.meaningZh: 涉及金钱或货币的
entries.en: The prize offers recognition as well as a small monetary award.
entries.zh: 这个奖项除了给予认可，还附有一笔小额奖金。

entries.meaningZh: 对文件或规则所作的正式修改
entries.en: The committee proposed an amendment to clarify the wording of the final clause.
entries.zh: 委员会提出了一项修正案，以澄清最后一条的措辞。

entries.meaningZh: 通过线索追查某事的来源或发展过程
entries.en: We tried to trace the error back to the original data file.
entries.zh: 我们试图追溯错误，找到它在原始数据文件中的源头。

entries.meaningZh: 使人免受天气或其他危险影响的避护处
entries.en: We found shelter beneath the station roof as the storm grew stronger.
entries.zh: 暴风雨越来越大时，我们在车站屋顶下找到了避雨处。

entries.meaningZh: 围绕某个问题持续存在的公开争论
entries.en: The building's unusual design caused controversy among residents and local historians.
entries.zh: 这座建筑不寻常的设计，在居民与当地历史研究者之间引起了争议。

entries.meaningZh: 乘船航行或驾驶帆船航行
entries.en: They plan to sail around the island when the weather improves.
entries.zh: 他们计划在天气好转后乘船绕岛航行。

entries.meaningZh: 颜色、声音或印象等逐渐变弱或消失
entries.en: The colours may fade if the photograph is left in direct sunlight.
entries.zh: 如果照片一直受到阳光直射，颜色可能会褪去。

entries.meaningZh: 用手或身体表达意思的动作
entries.en: With a small gesture, the guide invited us to move closer.
entries.zh: 导游做了一个小手势，示意我们靠近些。

entries.meaningZh: 造成严重伤痛或不幸的悲惨事件
entries.en: The tragedy brought neighbours together to support the families who had lost their homes.
entries.zh: 这场悲剧让邻居们团结起来，帮助那些失去家园的家庭。

entries.meaningZh: 赋予某人获得某物或做某事的权利
entries.en: These tickets entitle visitors to enter both exhibitions on the same day.
entries.zh: 持这些票的游客，有权在同一天参观两个展览。

entries.meaningZh: 具有一定风险的新项目或事业
entries.en: Their first business venture began with a borrowed sewing machine and three customers.
entries.zh: 他们的第一次创业，从一台借来的缝纫机和三位顾客开始。

entries.meaningZh: 通过用力挤压使某物变形或挤出液体
entries.en: Gently squeeze the lemon over the salad just before serving it.
entries.zh: 上桌之前，轻轻把柠檬汁挤在沙拉上。

entries.meaningZh: 遮盖全部或部分面部的面具
entries.en: The actor removed his mask after the audience had left the theatre.
entries.zh: 观众离开剧院后，演员摘下了面具。

entries.meaningZh: 很容易被注意到或占据显著位置的
entries.en: A prominent sign at the entrance explains how visitors can request assistance.
entries.zh: 入口处一块醒目的标牌，说明了游客如何寻求帮助。

entries.meaningZh: 负责调查案件、寻找线索的人
entries.en: The detective noticed a small detail that everyone else had overlooked.
entries.zh: 侦探注意到了一个其他人都忽略的小细节。

entries.meaningZh: 做出不符合某项规则、约定等的行为
entries.en: Sharing those private records would violate the agreement we signed.
entries.zh: 分享那些私人记录，会违反我们签署的协议。

entries.meaningZh: 以比较均匀的程度持续、没有大幅变化的
entries.en: The team made steady progress once everyone understood their individual responsibilities.
entries.zh: 每个人都弄清各自职责之后，团队便取得了持续而稳定的进展。

entries.meaningZh: 某人或某物最终会经历的命运或结局
entries.en: The committee has not yet decided the fate of the old theatre.
entries.zh: 委员会尚未决定这座老剧院的命运。

entries.meaningZh: 整体中可以区分出来的一部分
entries.en: The final segment of the programme features questions submitted by listeners.
entries.zh: 节目的最后一个环节呈现的是听众提交的问题。

entries.meaningZh: 不经常、只是偶尔发生的
entries.en: Apart from an occasional passing car, the village was completely quiet.
entries.zh: 除了偶尔驶过的一辆汽车，村庄一片宁静。

entries.meaningZh: 记录个人日常经历或感受的日记本
entries.en: She kept a diary during the trip to remember small moments later.
entries.zh: 旅行期间她坚持记日记，以便日后回忆那些小小的瞬间。

entries.meaningZh: 非常渴望某物或急切需要帮助等的
entries.en: By the end of the long walk, we were desperate for a drink.
entries.zh: 长途步行结束时，我们都急切地想喝点东西。

entries.meaningZh: 从事音乐演奏或创作的人
entries.en: The musician stayed after the performance to talk with the younger students.
entries.zh: 演出结束后，这位音乐家留下来与年纪较小的学生交谈。

entries.meaningZh: 面对可怕或极不愉快事情时的强烈恐惧与震惊
entries.en: To her horror, she discovered that the only copy had been deleted.
entries.zh: 令她惊恐的是，她发现唯一的副本已经被删除。

entries.meaningZh: 使受损或失灵的物品恢复可用状态
entries.en: They hope to repair the damaged roof before the next heavy rain.
entries.zh: 他们希望在下一场大雨来临前修好受损的屋顶。

entries.meaningZh: 为躲避危险而迅速逃离
entries.en: The rising floodwater forced several families to flee their homes before dawn.
entries.zh: 不断上涨的洪水，迫使几个家庭在黎明前逃离家园。

entries.meaningZh: 容易受到伤害、损害或不良影响的
entries.en: Without a reliable backup, the project remains vulnerable to accidental data loss.
entries.zh: 如果没有可靠的备份，项目仍容易受到意外数据丢失的影响。

entries.meaningZh: 纸张或页面正文之外的空白边缘
entries.en: Leave a wide margin so the reviewer has space for handwritten comments.
entries.zh: 请留出宽一些的页边空白，让审阅者有地方手写批注。

entries.meaningZh: 与现实不同、由想象创造出的情境或故事
entries.en: The novel mixes historical details with fantasy to create an unfamiliar world.
entries.zh: 这部小说把历史细节与幻想结合，创造了一个陌生的世界。

entries.meaningZh: 履行承诺或完成应尽的责任
entries.en: We must fulfil our promise to publish the results, including the unsuccessful trials.
entries.zh: 我们必须履行公布结果的承诺，包括那些未成功的试验。

entries.meaningZh: 研究人的心理和行为的学科
entries.en: Studying psychology changed the way she thought about everyday decisions.
entries.zh: 学习心理学改变了她思考日常决策的方式。

entries.meaningZh: 迅速抓住或把握一个机会
entries.en: We should seize this opportunity to test the idea with real users.
entries.zh: 我们应当抓住这个机会，让真实用户参与测试这个想法。

entries.meaningZh: 夫妻依法终止婚姻关系的离婚
entries.en: After the divorce, they continued to share responsibility for their children's education.
entries.zh: 离婚之后，他们仍共同承担孩子教育方面的责任。

entries.meaningZh: 主要用歌唱形式表演的戏剧作品或歌剧艺术
entries.en: The company performed a new opera based on a local legend.
entries.zh: 这个剧团演出了一部根据当地传说创作的新歌剧。

entries.meaningZh: 对周围事物保持知觉和清醒的状态
entries.en: The character slowly regains consciousness and realises that she is in an unfamiliar room.
entries.zh: 这个角色慢慢恢复意识，发现自己身处一个陌生的房间。

entries.meaningZh: 在国外或前往国外
entries.en: She worked overseas for several years before returning to her hometown.
entries.zh: 她在国外工作了几年，然后才回到家乡。

entries.meaningZh: 使公众注意到某人或某事的宣传与报道
entries.en: The exhibition attracted unexpected publicity after a visitor shared photographs online.
entries.zh: 一位游客在网上分享照片之后，这个展览获得了意外的关注与报道。

entries.meaningZh: 用于提醒人注意危险或某个情况的警报装置
entries.en: The alarm sounded while the building was being inspected before opening.
entries.zh: 建筑物在开放前接受检查时，警报响了。

entries.meaningZh: 一种化学元素，中文称为碳
entries.en: The diagram labels carbon and oxygen with different colours to help new students.
entries.zh: 这张图用不同颜色标出碳和氧，以帮助初学的学生。

entries.meaningZh: 除所提到的对象之外还包括其他对象
entries.en: Besides the main report, we submitted a short summary for general readers.
entries.zh: 除了主报告，我们还提交了一份面向普通读者的简短摘要。

entries.meaningZh: 物体突然爆裂并释放能量的爆炸
entries.en: The distant explosion shook the windows, but nobody in the house was hurt.
entries.zh: 远处的爆炸震动了窗户，不过屋里没有人受伤。

entries.meaningZh: 令人惊叹、几乎难以相信的
entries.en: The view from the summit was incredible despite the clouds below us.
entries.zh: 尽管下方云层密布，山顶的景色仍令人惊叹。

entries.meaningZh: 在困境中坚持斗争、不轻易放弃的人
entries.en: Even after repeated setbacks, her friends described her as a determined fighter.
entries.zh: 即使屡遭挫折，朋友们仍称她是个坚定不屈的斗士。

entries.meaningZh: 追踪并捕猎野生动物的人
entries.en: The story follows a hunter who becomes lost in the winter forest.
entries.zh: 这个故事讲述了一位在冬日森林中迷路的猎人的经历。

entries.meaningZh: 为获得好处而利用某种资源或机会
entries.en: The team hopes to exploit the material's flexibility without increasing production costs.
entries.zh: 团队希望利用这种材料的柔韧性，而不增加生产成本。

entries.meaningZh: 朋友之间亲近、互相信任的关系
entries.en: Their friendship continued through years of studying and working in different countries.
entries.zh: 尽管多年在不同国家学习和工作，他们的友谊一直延续着。

entries.meaningZh: 某个组织成员穿着的统一服装
entries.en: The guide wore a blue uniform with the museum's name on the pocket.
entries.zh: 导游穿着蓝色制服，口袋上印着博物馆的名称。

entries.meaningZh: 允许在约定期限内付费使用财产的租约
entries.en: The lease allows the family to keep a small dog in the flat.
entries.zh: 这份租约允许这家人在公寓里养一只小狗。

entries.meaningZh: 通过规则对某项活动进行管理或约束
entries.en: Clear rules govern how the committee selects and evaluates new projects.
entries.zh: 明确的规则规定了委员会如何挑选和评估新项目。

entries.meaningZh: 在数量、价值或作用上相等或相当的
entries.en: The two courses cover equivalent material but use different teaching methods.
entries.zh: 这两门课程涵盖相当的内容，但采用不同的教学方法。

entries.meaningZh: 引起公众震惊或不满的不当行为事件
entries.en: The scandal forced the organisation to review how it handled donations.
entries.zh: 这桩丑闻迫使该组织重新审视自己处理捐款的方式。

entries.meaningZh: 使别人对能力、品质等留下良好印象
entries.en: Her careful preparation is likely to impress the interview panel.
entries.zh: 她认真细致的准备，很可能会给面试小组留下良好印象。

entries.meaningZh: 公司分给股东的一部分利润，即股息
entries.en: The company paid a small dividend to its shareholders in June.
entries.zh: 这家公司在六月向股东支付了一笔小额股息。

entries.meaningZh: 朋友或伙伴，常用于英式非正式表达
entries.en: My old mate from school offered to help carry the boxes upstairs.
entries.zh: 我的老同学提出帮忙把箱子搬上楼。

entries.meaningZh: 为比较能力、选出优胜者而举行的比赛
entries.en: She entered a photography contest with a picture of the harbour at sunrise.
entries.zh: 她用一张日出时港口的照片参加了摄影比赛。

entries.meaningZh: 正式规定组织权利、目标或运行原则的章程
entries.en: The club's charter explains how members can propose changes to its rules.
entries.zh: 俱乐部的章程说明了成员如何提出修改规则的建议。

entries.meaningZh: 被许多人相信、实际上并不真实的说法
entries.en: The article challenges the myth that successful research always follows a straight path.
entries.zh: 这篇文章质疑了一种误解，即成功的研究总是沿着笔直的路径前进。

entries.meaningZh: 因失望、疲惫或宽慰等而发出的一声叹息
entries.en: He gave a quiet sigh of relief when the missing file appeared.
entries.zh: 丢失的文件出现时，他轻轻地松了一口气。

entries.meaningZh: 考虑周全、能作出良好判断的
entries.en: It was wise to test the backup before relying on it.
entries.zh: 在依赖备份之前先进行测试，是明智的做法。

entries.meaningZh: 理解别人不幸处境并为其感到难过的同情
entries.en: Her colleagues expressed sympathy when she explained why she needed time away.
entries.zh: 她解释自己为什么需要暂时离开工作后，同事们表达了同情。

entries.meaningZh: 引起强烈分歧和争论的
entries.en: The controversial proposal divided residents who agreed that some change was necessary.
entries.zh: 居民们虽然同意有必要作些改变，却被这项有争议的提案分成了不同阵营。

entries.meaningZh: 严格要求遵守规则或标准的
entries.en: The laboratory follows strict procedures for labelling and storing every sample.
entries.zh: 实验室对每份样本的标记和存放都遵循严格的程序。

entries.meaningZh: 使困难、痛苦或紧张等程度减轻
entries.en: A clear explanation helped ease their concerns about the unfamiliar process.
entries.zh: 清晰的解释帮助减轻了他们对陌生流程的担忧。

entries.meaningZh: 依靠旋翼升降和飞行的直升机
entries.en: A helicopter carried the survey team to a remote part of the island.
entries.zh: 一架直升机把勘测团队送到了岛上的偏远地区。

entries.meaningZh: 因内部压力或反应等突然爆裂
entries.en: The audience watched a fictional spacecraft explode on the cinema screen.
entries.zh: 观众看着一艘虚构的飞船在电影银幕上爆炸。

entries.meaningZh: 行动或回应及时迅速的
entries.en: Thank you for your prompt reply to my questions about the timetable.
entries.zh: 感谢你及时回复我关于时间表的问题。

entries.meaningZh: 暂时停止某项活动，等待之后恢复或决定
entries.en: Heavy rain forced the organisers to suspend the outdoor performance.
entries.zh: 大雨迫使主办方暂停了户外演出。

entries.meaningZh: 创作一段音乐或一部作品
entries.en: She hopes to compose a short piece for the school orchestra.
entries.zh: 她希望为学校管弦乐队创作一首短曲。

entries.meaningZh: 由一个群体共同作出或拥有的
entries.en: The project succeeded because of collective effort, not one person's work alone.
entries.zh: 这个项目的成功来自集体努力，而非某个人独自的工作。

entries.meaningZh: 汽车，主要用于美式非正式表达
entries.en: The museum's oldest auto still has its original leather seats.
entries.zh: 博物馆里最古老的汽车，仍保留着原来的皮革座椅。

entries.meaningZh: 带有或表达爱情意味的
entries.en: They chose a quiet restaurant for a romantic dinner by the water.
entries.zh: 他们选了一家安静的水边餐厅，享用浪漫的晚餐。

entries.meaningZh: 用棉花纤维制成的布料
entries.en: The shirt is made from soft cotton rather than synthetic fabric.
entries.zh: 这件衬衫由柔软的棉布制成，而不是化纤面料。

entries.meaningZh: 在原价基础上减去的一部分金额或比例
entries.en: Students can receive a discount by showing their university identification card.
entries.zh: 学生出示大学学生证即可享受折扣。

entries.meaningZh: 辞去某项职务的行为或正式通知
entries.en: The manager submitted her resignation after accepting a position closer to home.
entries.zh: 经理接受了一个离家更近的职位之后，递交了辞呈。

entries.meaningZh: 一种有橙色果皮、果肉多汁的柑橘类水果
entries.en: He peeled an orange and shared the segments with his younger brother.
entries.zh: 他剥了一个橙子，把橙瓣分给弟弟吃。

entries.meaningZh: 带来根本性重大变化的
entries.en: The new printing method seemed revolutionary compared with the equipment it replaced.
entries.zh: 与被替换的设备相比，这种新的印刷方法显得具有革命性。

entries.meaningZh: 使人感到受冒犯、侮辱或不快的
entries.en: The editor removed an offensive remark that added nothing to the discussion.
entries.zh: 编辑删掉了一句冒犯性评论，因为它对讨论毫无帮助。

entries.meaningZh: 经济活动、行业等快速增长的繁荣期
entries.en: The tourism boom created jobs but also increased pressure on local housing.
entries.zh: 旅游业的繁荣创造了就业机会，但也增加了当地住房的压力。

entries.meaningZh: 无需人每次手动操作即可自行运行的
entries.en: The automatic doors stayed open while the visitors carried their equipment inside.
entries.zh: 游客把设备搬进去时，自动门一直保持开启。

entries.meaningZh: 每周发生或进行一次的
entries.en: Our weekly meeting is short enough to leave time for individual work.
entries.zh: 我们每周一次的会议很简短，能留出时间开展个人工作。

entries.meaningZh: 有勇气或敢于做某事
entries.en: Few students would dare to question the result without checking the calculations first.
entries.zh: 很少有学生敢在未先核对计算的情况下质疑结果。

entries.meaningZh: 从银行账户等取出钱款的行为
entries.en: The receipt shows the date and amount of the cash withdrawal.
entries.zh: 这张收据列出了现金提取的日期和金额。

entries.meaningZh: 以幽默情节使观众发笑的作品
entries.en: We chose a light comedy after watching several serious documentaries.
entries.zh: 看了几部严肃的纪录片后，我们选了一部轻松的喜剧。

entries.meaningZh: 觉得某种不当或不利情况可能存在的怀疑
entries.en: The unexplained changes raised suspicion among people who had seen the earlier figures.
entries.zh: 看过早先数据的人，对这些未加解释的变化产生了怀疑。

entries.meaningZh: 不属于军队等武装力量的普通民众
entries.en: The documentary describes how a civilian helped reconnect families after the conflict.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片讲述了一名平民如何在冲突后帮助离散的家庭重新取得联系。

entries.meaningZh: 谷物植物结出的可作食物的籽粒
entries.en: A single grain of rice lay beside the empty bowl.
entries.zh: 空碗旁边落着一粒米。

entries.meaningZh: 强烈公开表示某种行为不可接受
entries.en: The committee issued a statement to condemn the deliberate destruction of the archive.
entries.zh: 委员会发表声明，谴责蓄意毁坏档案的行为。

entries.meaningZh: 正式公开表达立场、意图等的声明
entries.en: Their declaration of support encouraged other groups to join the campaign.
entries.zh: 他们公开表达支持的声明，鼓励了其他团体加入这次活动。

entries.meaningZh: 在戏剧、电影等作品中扮演角色的女演员
entries.en: The actress spent several weeks studying the accent needed for her role.
entries.zh: 这位女演员花了几周时间，学习角色所需的口音。

entries.meaningZh: 儿童或年轻人，常用于较随意的表达
entries.en: A local youngster volunteered to show us the path to the harbour.
entries.zh: 当地一位年轻人主动提出，给我们指一指通往港口的小路。
